Select distinct compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for molecules reported in document CHEMBL5725984. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725984'. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
